'''2R-CH''', also known as '''Torch''', was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] equipped with a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] who worked with the [[Advozse Hegemony]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], 2R-CH occupied [[Hammer Station]] with other Hegemony forces and was eventually [[Battle for Hammer Station|destroyed]] by a strike team that proceeded to destroy the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
2R-CH "Torch" is one of the three enemies, along with [[Vorgan]] the Volcano and Sawbones [[Gjonfs]], who comprise Riflor's Champions, the second boss encounter in the "Hammer Station" Flashpoint in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. With Game Update 2.0 and the addition of a Hard Mode for Hammer Station, 2R-CH's character model was changed to a different type of droid.
